attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_email_support_pipeline
steps:
  - id: authenticate_gmail_agent
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "gmail_support_agent"
    output: auth_result

  - id: poll_inbox
    op: wait_for_condition
    params:
      condition: "new_unread_email_in_inbox"
      poll_interval_minutes: 5
    output: inbox_trigger

  - id: fetch_unread_emails
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/gmail/api/messages?q=is:unread"
    output: raw_emails

  - id: validate_raw_emails
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_emails
      schema: gmail_message_schema
    output: validated_emails

  - id: extract_email_fields
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_emails
      fields:
        - "body"
        - "threadId"
        - "senderAddress"
    output: email_fields

  - id: fetch_thread_history
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/gmail/api/threads/{threadId}"
      thread_id_source: email_fields
    output: raw_thread

  - id: validate_thread
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_thread
      schema: gmail_thread_schema
    output: validated_thread

  - id: build_thread_context
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_thread
      mapping:
        label_sender_type: true
        categorize_messages_by: "sender_role"
        output_format: "thread_history_with_labels"
    output: thread_context

  - id: classify_email
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "classify_email_type"
      input_fields:
        email_body: email_fields
        thread_context: thread_context
      categories:
        - "customer_support_request"
        - "internal_email"
        - "other"
    output: classification_result

  - id: route_on_classification
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "classification_result == 'customer_support_request'"
      true_step: search_knowledge_bases
      false_step: log_skip_non_support

  - id: log_skip_non_support
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: email_fields
      event: "email_skipped_not_customer_support"
      details:
        classification: classification_result
    output: skip_log_result

  - id: terminate_non_support
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "skipped_non_support_email"

  - id: search_knowledge_bases
    op: parallel_execute
    params:
      branches:
        - step: search_customer_support_docs
        - step: search_club_documents
        - step: search_previous_email_responses
    output: parallel_search_trigger

  - id: search_customer_support_docs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/knowledge/api/search/customerSupportDocs"
      query_source: email_fields
    output: raw_support_docs

  - id: search_club_documents
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/knowledge/api/search/clubDocuments"
      query_source: email_fields
    output: raw_club_docs

  - id: search_previous_email_responses
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/knowledge/api/search/previousEmailResponses"
      query_source: email_fields
    output: raw_previous_responses

  - id: validate_support_docs
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_support_docs
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: valid_support_docs

  - id: validate_club_docs
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_club_docs
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: valid_club_docs

  - id: validate_previous_responses
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_previous_responses
      schema: knowledge_base_result_schema
    output: valid_previous_responses

  - id: merge_kb_support_and_club
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: valid_support_docs
      secondary: valid_club_docs
      key: "topic"
    output: merged_support_club

  - id: merge_all_knowledge
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: merged_support_club
      secondary: valid_previous_responses
      key: "topic"
    output: all_knowledge_results

  - id: detect_language_and_season
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "detect_language_and_season_mapping"
      input_fields:
        email_body: email_fields
      language_options:
        - "EN"
        - "FR"
        - "ES"
      season_mapping:
        fall: "Winter (Oct-Apr)"
        spring: "Summer (May-Sep)"
    output: language_season_context

  - id: generate_draft_response
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: all_knowledge_results
      mapping:
        thread_context: thread_context
        email_fields: email_fields
        language: language_season_context
        instructions: "generate_response_from_knowledge_base_only"
        response_language_match: true
        season_context: language_season_context
    output: draft_response_content

  - id: format_draft_for_gmail
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: draft_response_content
      format: "gmail_draft_json"
      include_fields:
        - "to"
        - "threadId"
        - "subject"
        - "body_html"
        - "language"
    output: formatted_draft

  - id: create_gmail_draft
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: formatted_draft
      url: "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/drafts"
      method: "POST"
      content_type: "application/json"
      note: "Creates draft only - does not send"
    output: draft_creation_result

  - id: validate_draft_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: draft_creation_result
      schema: gmail_draft_response_schema
    output: validated_draft_result

  - id: log_draft_creation
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_draft_result
      event: "gmail_draft_created"
      details:
        thread_id: email_fields
        sender: email_fields
        language: language_season_context
        draft_id: validated_draft_result
    output: audit_log_result

  - id: terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "draft_created_successfully"
